name: Pulley
description: Pulley is an equity and cap table management platform for stakeholders, securities, vesting, ownership, fundraising, valuations, stock-based compensation, tax workflows, token cap tables, documents, signatures, reports, and employee equity portals.
agentUseSummary: Pulley documents product-native HRIS, custodian, SSO, and tightly limited Okta SCIM integrations, but no customer-authorized Pulley account API or hosted MCP contract. Relay therefore mounts no connection or tools.

blocked.label: Connect a Pulley company
blocked.description: Pulley does not publish a customer-authorized account API or hosted MCP contract for third-party access to a company.

blocked.label: Read Pulley data
blocked.description: Cap tables, stakeholders, securities, vesting, ownership, valuations, transactions, documents, signatures, tasks, reports, tax data, token data, users, permissions, and audit history remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change Pulley
blocked.description: Equity issuance and transfer, stakeholder and security changes, invitations, signatures, exercises, reports, integrations, permissions, exports, and every mutation remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled without a reviewed, distributable Pulley customer API or hosted MCP contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Pulley customer authorization contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No Pulley customer authorization contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Pulley's public help center documents native HRIS connections, custodian credentials stored by Pulley, provider-specific inbound BitGo callback endpoints, SAML SSO, and a Pulley-generated SCIM token and fixed /scim/v2 endpoint for Okta to push new users only. The reviewed public first-party surface does not publish an external customer authorization method, company or account origin, least-privilege scope or role model for general automation, cap-table endpoint or tool schema, pagination, rate limits, outbound webhooks, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect behavior, or non-production contract. The SCIM token is an identity-provisioning credential and the callback endpoints receive custodian events; neither authorizes Relay to read or manage Pulley equity data. Browser or private-endpoint automation is not an acceptable fallback.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Pulley login or SCIM credentials, reuse custodian credentials granted to Pulley, show Connect, or automate the web or mobile clients. Reconsider Pulley only after it publishes or contractually supplies a distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract with exact company and server origins, authentication, least-privilege permissions, tools or endpoints and schemas, pagination and rate limits, webhook behavior, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, and non-production test access.

evidence.supports: Pulley documents SAML SSO and a Pulley-generated bearer token for Okta SCIM at /scim/v2 with only Push New Users enabled; this is an identity-provisioning contract, not a general Pulley account API.

Pulley documents storing a BitGo access token and publishes Pulley callback URLs for BitGo approvals and transfers; these are native custodian integration surfaces rather than customer-authorized Pulley data endpoints.

Pulley separates administrators with company-wide cap-table, stakeholder, financial, task, document, issuance, and transfer access from stakeholders limited to their own holdings, vesting, documents, and exercises.

Pulley documents admin-gated reports containing cap tables, grants, cancellations, exercises, repurchases, compensation, vesting, taxes, and stakeholder data, reinforcing critical risk and fail-closed handling.

Pulley's privacy policy covers personal data collected through its services and incorporates the current Terms of Use, supporting the decision not to infer undocumented access to customer equity records.
Pulley's current terms govern use of its websites, products, services, applications, subscriptions, and customer relationship without supplying a public third-party automation contract.
